const REQUIRED_TABS = ["Order Tracking Details", "D by D Ads", "D by D Website Funnel", "Month to Month Products Analysis", "Website Mapping and Metrics"];
const DEFAULT_BUSINESS = { id: "ultramedix", name: "Ultramedix", spreadsheetId: null, isDefault: true };

async function getBusinesses(env) {
  const defaults = [{ ...DEFAULT_BUSINESS, spreadsheetId: env.SPREADSHEET_ID }];
  if (!env.BUSINESS_STORE) return defaults;
  let saved = [];
  try { saved = await env.BUSINESS_STORE.get("businesses", "json") || []; } catch { saved = []; }
  if (!Array.isArray(saved)) saved = [];
  const extras = saved.filter(b => b && b.id && b.id !== "ultramedix" && b.spreadsheetId);
  return [...defaults, ...extras];
}
async function getBusiness(env, id = "ultramedix") {
  return (await getBusinesses(env)).find(b => b.id === id) || null;
}
async function validateBusiness(env, name, spreadsheetUrl) {
  let spreadsheetId = "";
  try { const u = new URL(spreadsheetUrl); const match = u.pathname.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/); spreadsheetId = match ? match[1] : ""; } catch {}
  if (!spreadsheetId) throw new Error("Please provide a valid Google Sheets URL.");
  for (const tab of REQUIRED_TABS) await readPublicSheet(spreadsheetId, tab, "A1:A1");
  const id = String(name).toLowerCase().normalize("NFKD").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "").slice(0, 48) || ("business-" + crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8));
  return { id, name: String(name).trim(), spreadsheetId, spreadsheetTitle: String(name).trim(), isDefault: false };
}
function json(data, status = 200, headers = {}) {

}

const ULTRAMEDIX_SHEET_CACHE_TTL=180;
async function readPublicSheet(spreadsheetId,title,range,rawMode=false){
  // Per-sheet cache: avoids hammering Google gviz for every dashboard tab or comparison.
  const part=[spreadsheetId,title,range||"",rawMode?"raw":"values"].join("|");
  const root="https://ultramedix-analytics-api.islam-ahmed-solutions.workers.dev/__internal_sheet_cache?source="+encodeURIComponent(part);
  const cache=caches.default, freshKey=new Request(root), staleKey=new Request(root+"&fallback=1");
  try{
    const found=await cache.match(freshKey);
    if(found)return await found.json();
  }catch(_){}
  try{
    const rows=await readPublicSheetOriginal(spreadsheetId,title,range,rawMode);
    const payload=JSON.stringify(rows);
    if(payload.length<18000000){
      const fresh=new Response(payload,{headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","Cache-Control":"public,max-age="+ULTRAMEDIX_SHEET_CACHE_TTL}});
      const stale=new Response(payload,{headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","Cache-Control":"public,max-age=86400"}});
      // Cache writes are best-effort; failure cannot make the dashboard fail.
      try{await Promise.allSettled([cache.put(freshKey,fresh),cache.put(staleKey,stale)]);}catch(_){}
    }
    return rows;
  }catch(error){
    try{
      const lastGood=await cache.match(staleKey);
      if(lastGood){console.warn("Serving last known good data for "+title+" after upstream error: "+String(error));return await lastGood.json();}
    }catch(_){}
    throw error;
  }
}

function dateCandidates(value, startDate, endDate) {

function sourceTrafficType(value) {
  const v=norm(value).replace(/[ -]+/g,"_");
  if (!v) return "Unknown";
  if (/(^|_)link_in_bio($|_)/.test(v)) return "Organic";
  return "Paid";
}
function sourceChannel(value) {
  const raw=String(value??"").trim();
  if (!raw || /unknown source/i.test(raw)) return "Unknown";
  const candidate=raw.toLowerCase();
  if (/(^|[^a-z])instagram([^a-z]|$)|instagram\.com/.test(candidate)) return "Instagram";
  if (/(^|[^a-z])facebook([^a-z]|$)|facebook\.com|fb\.com/.test(candidate)) return "Facebook";
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) {
    try { const host=new URL(raw).hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,""); return host.split(".")[0].replace(/^m$/,"").replace(/[-_]+/g," ").replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase())||"Unknown"; } catch {}
  }
  return raw.replace(/[_-]+/g," ").replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase());
}
function cleanedTrafficType(value) {
  const v=norm(value);

}
